independentSourceChecks.footPivotReferenceLimit: The copied module has a different private PIVOT object identity. Numeric pivot values and current placement consumers are preserved; universal constant-reference identity is not claimed.

supportedScopeAndLimits: Genuine QA-owned original assets with untouched native Canvas methods/accessors on successful calls are the supported path.
The body canvas logically snapshots the pre-weapon body before armed GL; the intervening original GL and colour/ink composition do not write that body canvas in the supported path.

Universal exceptional side-effect order is impossible: a deferred getImageData failure follows armed/compositor work, while an armed/compositor failure can precede body reading. The same thrown value is forwarded without retry, not an identical amount of preceding drawing.

Mutation of global ImageData or HTMLCanvas accessors, Three render-graph prototypes/callbacks, or arbitrary foreign graph callbacks that write the body canvas is unsupported. No comprehensive hostile-object-graph traversal or universal compatibility claim is made.
The raw copied candidate class is not a standalone direct-alpha implementation; only the guarded installer routes supported calls to its raster method.
FNV guards are consumer checks, not cryptographic provenance. Pinned whole-source SHA256 and inverse-source evidence are separate.
Deferring the read does not remove bodyCanvas drawImage, fullRGBA allocation/read, GPU wait or compositor work. It can merely move a stall; improvement is unproven.
Existing strict wholeCanvas original A/A failures remain unresolved and cannot be replaced by same-context quality evidence.
